text:
Megan (Partner Ops): Quick thread — pulling together a coalition launch checklist for CloudRange (marketplace), TitanHW (hardware), and Forge SI. Need QBR-ready scorecard + MDF scenario rows by EOD Friday. Main asks: recommended co-funding profiles, announcement runway, lead-gen credit mechanics, and clear success metrics (joint pipeline / SQLs).

Raj: Ack. Is there a template for the scorecard we should use?

Megan (Partner Ops): Yes — use the 'Coalition QBR template' tab in this doc: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1XabcDEFghiJklMnopQRs. Please populate one row per partner and include these cols: ARR influence, HW credit spend, MDF ask, GTM channels, top 3 risks, measurement tags.

Lucas (Marketplace): For TitanHW — baseline MDF options I'm thinking: `Option A: $100k` (co-fund 50/50), `Option B: $50k` (referral credit model). Measurement via partner-tagged opps + UTM. Which column should I drop hardware credits into?

Megan (Partner Ops): Put hardware credits under `HW credit spend` and add a short justification in `Notes`. For finance sanity checks, use this calc snippet: `ROI = (est_pipeline * conv_rate * avg_rev) / MDF`. Finance will review Monday.

Emily W: Quick question on announcement cadence — single day joint press release or staged (marketplace listing first, PR + webinar later)?

Raj: Staged. Day 0: marketplace listing + console docs. Day 14: joint PR + webinar once SI case study has a first customer quote. Less risk and gives SI time to validate integration.

Megan (Partner Ops): Agreed. Also need logo/co-brand approvals — Lucas, can you own TitanHW legal touchpoint? @legal-ops for partner T&Cs?

partners-bot: calendar invite created — "Partner Coalition QBR prep" Mon 09:00 AM PT. Meeting link: https://meet.link/xyz.

Raj: I'll add two MDF scenarios in the sheet: conservative and upside, and include tracking tags `utm_partner` and `partner_credit_code` for attribution.

Megan (Partner Ops): Please separate MDF rows by market (NA / EU / APAC) so we can model regional budgets/claims. Flag any SIs who will need enablement credits or professional services discounts.

Lucas (Marketplace): Noted — I'll get TitanHW numbers (credits + expected HW rebate) by EOD Thu and drop logos into the doc.

Emily W: I'll draft PR timeline and speaker list and add to the 'comms' tab. Also proposing a small joint webinar (30-40 min) Day 14 with a tech demo + customer panel.

Megan (Partner Ops): Perfect — if anyone else is reading, drop a quick reaction or DM me if blocked. I’ll consolidate inputs Friday evening and send a one-pager for the QBR. :thumbsup:
